title: Targeted live-source follow-up — 16 November 2026
lede: A targeted follow-up checked the three supplied Amazon short links, the two volatile manufacturer-hosted review counters, the current Emeril product-page conflict, and the official affiliate/disclosure sources most material to the site. This is not a full re-read of every published specification row.
scope_note: Observed by fetching the official source pages on 2026-11-16. Amazon short-link results are recorded as observed redirect destinations only: each URL retained plpRedirect=mhFallback, so these observations do not prove that the account holder intended those products or that the links carry an Associates tag. Manufacturer review counts are volatile and are dated; they are not Amazon ratings.

rows.claim: Emeril brand-page rating and preset-count conflict
rows.previous: Brand page previously recorded as 2.6 (25 reviews), with conflicting preset claims.
rows.observed: The page displayed 2.6 (25); its spec strip still says 25 Cooking Pre-sets, the description still says 10-in-1, and an image is described as an 11-in-1 convection oven. The Amazon title observed through the supplied link says 24 one-touch preset options.
rows.verdict: Rating unchanged; product-page and listing claims remain conflicted; no single preset count is inferred.

additional_sources.label: Amazon supplied short link — current listing title

rows.claim: Amazon Associates commission table and policy version
rows.previous: Policies page dated April 14, 2026; Table 1 commission rates previously recorded.
rows.observed: The official policies page still states Updated: April 14, 2026. The official rate table still lists Physical Books, Kitchen, Automotive at 4.50%, Home in the 3.00% row, and All Other Categories at 4.00%; no per-ASIN category mapping was observed.
rows.verdict: Confirmed unchanged; per-product commission remains unverified.

rows.previous: FTC Disclosures 101 is cited for placement and experience claims.
rows.observed: The FTC guidance still says disclosures should be hard to miss and warns not to describe experience with a product that was not tried.
rows.verdict: Official source re-read; no compliance copy changed.
rows.source_label: FTC — Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers

rows.claim: Current eCFR status for 16 CFR Part 255
rows.previous: 16 CFR Part 255, including §255.5, is cited by the site.
rows.observed: The eCFR page reports Title 16 up to date as of 2026-11-12 and lists 16 CFR Part 255, including §255.5.
rows.verdict: Official source re-read; no compliance copy changed.

irregularities: All three supplied Amazon links again displayed fallback-handler parameters. Do not describe the destination observation as confirmation of the owner's intended listing, the Associates tag, or attribution.

The Emeril page's current content includes 25 Cooking Pre-sets, 10-in-1 copy, and an image identified as 11-in-1, while the Amazon title says 24 one-touch preset options. The existing conflict remains open; the product comparison continues to avoid selecting one count.

The two Chefman manufacturer review counts increased between 2026-11-15 and 2026-11-16. These are brand-site counters, not Amazon ratings, and should not be treated as stable trend or conversion data.
